# CHOIR Body Map source snapshot

These files are an unmodified source snapshot used to generate Tender's interactive body-map geometry.

- Source: `https://github.com/ctsit/imagemap`
- Source commit: `0bf201d6cb95c7eaedb5449b36e4fa1d9cd9907f`
- Retrieved: 2026-07-26
- Module license: Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE`

The original body was devised by Dr. Ming-Chih J Kao and Professor Sean Mackey at Stanford University as part of CHOIR. The source project requires CHOIR attribution to remain with use of the body-map images.

Publication citation:

> Salmasi V, Hong J, Cramer E, et al. Development and validation of the Collaborative Health Outcomes Information Registry body map. PAIN Reports. 2021;6(1):e880. doi:10.1097/PR9.0000000000000880.

Tender preserves the source HTML coordinate maps and PNG images here. Generated TypeScript geometry retains the original `f01`–`f36` and `b01`–`b38` keys with a `choir-` namespace.
